learning_outcomes.text: Apply acquired knowledge to identify, formulate, and solve problems in broad contexts, being able to integrate them while working in multidisciplinary teams.
Understand the impact of engineering on the environment, the sustainable development of society, and the importance of working in a professional and responsible environment.
Communicate knowledge and conclusions, both orally and in writing, to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Knowledge and abilities to organize and manage projects. Know the organizational structure and functions of a project office.
Possess learning skills that allow for continuous study throughout life for adequate professional development.
Incorporate ICT and Industrial Engineering technologies and tools in professional activities.
Know and apply knowledge of basic sciences and technologies to the practice of Industrial Engineering.
Organization and planning of projects and human teams. Teamwork and leadership ability.
Knowledge and abilities to prepare the budget and the planning and scheduling of industrial manufacturing projects.
Knowledge and abilities to evaluate product design and manage quality in industrial manufacturing projects.
Knowledge and abilities to use tools for analysis and improvement of industrial manufacturing.
Knowledge and abilities to draft, develop, and manage industrial engineering projects.
Knowledge and abilities to carry out legalization projects for industrial activities.

syllabus_topics: Legislation and legal processing of industrial projects
Analysis and improvement of work processes
assessment_rules: The final grade is a weighted average of problems/exercises (10%), group practice (15%), and a final written exam (75%). To pass, all assessable activities must be completed, and a minimum score of 3 points must be obtained in each activity, with a weighted average of 5 points or higher. If any activity scores less than 3 points, the final grade will be 4 points if the weighted average is 4 or higher, otherwise it will be the weighted average. Students who pass the individual problems and group practice in the ordinary call but fail the course can retain these partial grades for the extraordinary call of the following year.
